        "reproducibility": "Consistent across runs"
    }


def calculate_modularity(G, partition):
    """Calculates the modularity score of a graph partition."""
    m = nx.number_of_edges(G)
    k_i = [G.degree(v) for v in G.nodes()]
    sigma_k = sum(k_i[i] * partition[v] for i, v in enumerate(G.nodes())) / m
    delta = 0.0

        for j, u in enumerate(G.nodes()):
            if partition[v] != partition[u] and G.has_edge(v, u):
                delta += partition[v] * partition[u]
    return delta / (2 * m)


def calculate_normalized_cut(G, partition):
    """Calculates the normalized cut score of a graph partition."""
    cut_size = 0
    for u, v in G.edges():
        if partition[u] != partition[v]:
            cut_size += 1
    return cut_size / (2 * nx.number_of_edges(G))


def calculate_balance_constraint(G, partition):
    """Calculates the balance constraint score of a graph partition."""
    degree_sum = sum(G.degree(v) for v in G.nodes())

    return abs(domain_sizes[0] - domain_sizes[1])


def calculate_approximation_ratio(G, partition):
    """Calculates the approximation ratio of a graph partition."""
    max_degree = max(G.degree(v) for v in G.nodes())
    return max_degree / (1.0 if len(G.nodes()) == 1 else len(G.nodes()) / 2)
